onboarding.removeBody: Only the hook entries Agent Pets wrote are removed. Your own settings and other hooks stay, and the shared hook script is kept while another tool still uses it.
onboarding.removeDone: Agent Pets integration removed. Your other settings were left as they were.
onboarding.cleanupBody: This removes all agent hooks and plugins, the shared hook script, connection tokens and the files in ~/.desktop-pet. Your own settings and other hooks stay. The pet will stay offline until you reinstall.
onboarding.cleanupDone: Cleanup finished. Run this before uninstalling the app.
onboarding.mcpReviewHelp: Tick the tools to set up; Agent Pets writes only the ticked files. Tools that look in use are pre-selected.
onboarding.mcpPlanModify: One agent-pets entry will be added to the existing file
onboarding.mcpTrackedWarning: Git already tracks this file, so your local paths could be committed.
onboarding.mcpTrackedSelected: Some selected files are tracked by Git. They contain paths from your computer; review before committing, or set them up by hand.
onboarding.mcpLocalOnlyHelp: The settings contain paths from your computer that mean nothing to teammates. This adds the new files to the project's .git/info/exclude so Git ignores them.
onboarding.mcpNotGitRepo: This folder is not a Git project. The settings contain local paths, so do not share them.
onboarding.mcpCopySnippet: Copy settings to paste by hand
onboarding.mcpTrackedResult: Git tracks these files, so the local paths in them could be committed: {files}
onboarding.mcpNext.claude: The first time Claude Code loads this project's .mcp.json you must approve agent-pets in /mcp.
onboarding.mcpNext.codex: Codex reads .codex/config.toml only for trusted projects; trust this project in Codex first.
onboarding.mcpCode.entry_changed: The entry was changed, so it was not removed
onboarding.mcpCode.server_mismatch: The project already has a different agent-pets entry, so nothing was changed. You can paste the settings by hand.
onboarding.mcpCode.servers_not_object: The server field is not an object, so nothing was changed.
onboarding.mcpCode.legacy_format: Uses the legacy format; set it up again to migrate.
onboarding.mcpCode.jsonc: This file has comments or trailing commas (JSONC) and Agent Pets will not rewrite it. Paste the settings by hand.
onboarding.mcpCode.invalid_json: This file is not valid JSON, so nothing was changed.
onboarding.mcpCode.root_not_object: The top level of this file is not an object, so nothing was changed.
onboarding.mcpCode.too_large: The file is over the 1 MB limit, so nothing was changed.
onboarding.mcpCode.unsafe_file: This is not a regular file (it may be a link), so nothing was changed.
onboarding.mcpCode.write_failed: Writing failed; check the folder permissions.
onboarding.introStatusTitle: See what your AI tools are doing
onboarding.introStatusBody: The pet reacts to Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode: thinking, running a tool, waiting for you, done or failed.
onboarding.introPermissionTitle: A nudge when you are needed
onboarding.introPermissionBody: When a tool needs your approval the pet speaks up. Only OpenCode can be allowed or denied right on the pet; other tools show Waiting and you confirm in the tool itself.
onboarding.introGrowthBody: Finished work earns XP so your pet levels up, evolves and unlocks achievements. Everything stays on your computer.
onboarding.introNext: Next, install the hooks for your tools (about a minute). Agent Pets only adds its own entries and backs up your config files before changing them.
onboarding.nextSteps: Connected. Restart your AI tools and the pet will start showing their status. You can reopen this wizard from Settings → Advanced.
onboarding.outcome.unchanged: Already up to date; nothing changed.
onboarding.backupMade: Your previous config was backed up to {path}.
onboarding.restartCodex: Restart Codex, then run any prompt; the pet will start showing its status.
onboarding.restartClaudeCode: Restart Claude Code (both CLI and Desktop).
onboarding.errorConfigUnparseable: {path} is not valid JSON (comments and trailing commas are not supported), so Agent Pets did not change it. Fix it and try again.
onboarding.errorConfigUnsafe: {path} is not a regular file, so it was not changed.
onboarding.errorConfigTooLarge: {path} is too large, so it was not changed.
onboarding.errorPermissionDenied: No permission to write{path}. Check the file or folder permissions.
onboarding.errorFileBusy: The file is in use by another program{path}. Close that tool and retry.
onboarding.errorReadOnly: The disk or folder is read-only{path}, so settings cannot be written.
onboarding.errorUnknown: Installation failed. Use Diagnose to see detailed checks.
onboarding.check.opencode-cli.warn: OpenCode CLI plugin is not installed (ignore this if you only use the Desktop app).
onboarding.check.opencode-desktop.warn: OpenCode Desktop plugin is not installed (ignore this if you only use the CLI).
onboarding.check.plugin-current.warn: An installed plugin is out of date.
onboarding.check.permission-channel.pass: Permission replies use a dedicated local broker channel.
onboarding.check.hooks-enabled.fail: config.toml has no hooks = true under [features], so Codex will not run hooks.
onboarding.check.hook-script-current.war: The hook script is out of date.
onboarding.check.hook-command.pass: The Agent Pets hook command is configured.
onboarding.check.hook-command.fail: The Agent Pets hook command is not configured.
onboarding.check.node.pass: The Node.js executable used by the hook exists.
onboarding.check.node.fail: The Node.js executable used by the hook is missing or not an absolute path.
onboarding.check.agent-present.pass: This tool has a configuration folder on this machine.
onboarding.check.agent-present.warn: No configuration folder for this tool was found; it may not be installed.
onboarding.check.loopback.pass: The receiver binds to loopback only.
onboarding.check.token.pass: Requests need the token created at install time.
onboarding.check.permissions.pass: Generic HTTP is observe-only and cannot answer Permission.
onboarding.fix.hooks-file: Press Repair to write the hooks again.
onboarding.fix.hooks-enabled: Press Repair to add hooks = true under [features].
onboarding.fix.settings-file: Press Install to create the file and add the hooks.
onboarding.fix.hook-script: Press Repair to deploy the hook script again.
onboarding.fix.hook-script-current: Press Repair to update the hook script.
onboarding.fix.plugin-current: Press Repair to update the plugin.
onboarding.fix.hook-command: Press Repair to write the hook command again.
onboarding.fix.node: Install Node.js (22 or newer recommended), then press Repair to write the full path.
onboarding.summary.degraded: Some settings are missing or out of date; repair recommended.
onboarding.waitRealTitle: Run any prompt in your tool; this waits 30 seconds for an event the tool itself sends. This is the true end-to-end check.
onboarding.testReceiverTitle: Only checks that this Agent Pets can receive a local event; it does not involve your tool and still passes when the hook is broken.
onboarding.realEventOk: Received a real event from {source} ({time}). The connection works.
onboarding.realEventTimeout: No event from {name} within 30 seconds. Check in order: 1) the tool was restarted; 2) press Diagnose to inspect the hook and Node path; 3) nothing else is using local port 17373.
onboarding.capStatus: Status on the pet (thinking, done, error)
onboarding.capPermissionRespond: Allow or deny Permission right on the pet bubble
onboarding.capPermissionObserve: The pet shows "Waiting Permission", but you approve inside {name}
onboarding.errorNodeMissing: Node.js was not found. Install Node.js 18 or newer (nodejs.org) and press Install again; the hook needs it to reach the pet.
onboarding.errorNodeUnsupported: The detected Node.js is too old. Upgrade to 18 or newer and try again.
onboarding.mcpRecovered: The project list file was unreadable; it was set aside as a backup and the list restarted. Add your projects again with Choose project folder.
onboarding.mcpCode.stale_paths: Agent Pets wrote this entry but its paths are outdated (App moved or Node upgraded). Press Update paths to repair it.
onboarding.check.runtime.warn: Setup operations are unavailable in this runtime.
onboarding.mcpConcepts: Hooks tell the pet what your tools are doing (global, no project needed). Project pets give each project its own pet. The MCP setup here lets an AI tool in a project make the pet speak and react.
onboarding.mcpWarnGitOutside: This project's .git points outside the project folder, so the local-only exclude list was not written for safety. The config files may be tracked by Git.
onboarding.mcpWarnExcludeFailed: Couldn't write .git/info/exclude, so the config files may be tracked by Git. Check the folder permissions and try again.
